task: ae.sat CDCL SAT solver (2-watched literals, 1-UIP, VSIDS, Luby restarts) with independent model and RUP proof checkers, DIMACS parser, encodings
reasoning_summary: Built a CDCL solver test-first and made every answer independently verifiable: models by ModelChecker, UNSAT by a RUP proof checker that shares no code with the solver. Differential testing against brute force on 400 seeded random 3-SAT instances plus pigeonhole, queens and colouring families all pass; a mutation of clause learning was caught by 6 tests. Two test-expectation defects (end-of-input line number, instance mix) were fixed on the second run.
